At Western Avenue, the proposed improvement merges the six-lane cross-section into a four-lane section which then follows the existing centerline of Lincoln Highway to Edgewood Avenue where the cross-section narrows from two 24-foot lanes to two 22-foot lanes to adjust to the cross-section of the western end of the improvement at Lincoln Highway and Chicago Road. Through this section, from Western Avenue to Edgewood Avenue, the built-up urban nature of the area precludes moving the location off the existing centerline of Lincoln Highway.
2. Alignment "B"
Alignment "B" investigates the potential of shifting the new road centerline to either side to place the additional right-of-way takings entirely on one side. For the portion of the route west of Western Avenue the preferred combination of these shifts to north or south of the present centerline was used. East of Western Avenue through the heavily developed areas the alignment is identical to that used for Alignment "A". Right-of-way takings in this area are minimized by placing the new centerline on the existing centerline.
From Cicero Avenue eastward to Kildare Avenue the new centerline is moved to the north of the existing centerline. Although the area is lightly developed, fewer improvements are effected by taking all new right-of-way on the north.
Fr m Kildare Avenue to Crawford Avenue the improvement is swung to the south as in Alignment "A" to minimize disruption to the Butterfield Creek Tributary and to miss the drainage structures along the Korvette Shopping Plaza. Similarly, east of Crawford Avenue the line moves to the north to miss two adjacent cemeteries on the south side of Lincoln Highway.
From Roslyn Road all the way to Western Avenue the line remains shifted to the north holding to the existing right-of-way line along the south side, as throughout this area the development is greater on the south side of Lincoln Highway.
